_label: baseline: current 4-param response-shaping surface (summary tri-state, fields, mode, impl_only)
_source: input_schemas are the schemars serialization of aptu_coder_core::types::AnalyzeFileParams and AnalyzeSymbolParams generated from worktree 20260914_65 (origin/main HEAD, post-#1543 mode enum) on 2026-09-14 via schema_for! in a scratch test; $defs inlined into properties. Tool descriptions are literal production text.

analyze_file.name: analyze_file
analyze_file.description: Functions, types, classes, and imports from a single source file. Fails if directory path supplied; use analyze_directory instead. Paginates with cursor/page_size; use fields=["functions","classes","imports"] to limit sections. git_ref not supported. Use analyze_module for a lightweight function/import index (~75% smaller). Supported: Astro, C/C++, C#, CSS, Fortran, Go, HTML, Java, JavaScript, JSON, Kotlin, Markdown, Python, Rust, TOML, TSX, TypeScript, YAML.

fields.description:
Limit output to specific sections. Valid values: "functions", "classes", "imports", "all".
The FILE header (path, line count, section counts) is always emitted regardless.
Omitting this field returns all sections (current behavior).
Ignored when summary=true (summary takes precedence).

cursor.description:
Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor` field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.
Must be a valid opaque token or omitted entirely; passing an empty string is invalid and is treated as omitted.
Mutually exclusive with summary=true; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

summary.description:
true = compact summary (totals plus directory tree, no per-file function lists); false = full output; unset = auto-summarize when output exceeds 50K chars.
Mutually exclusive with cursor; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

analyze_symbol.name: analyze_symbol
analyze_symbol.description: Call graph for a named symbol across all files in a directory. Prefer over analyze_file when the question is "who calls X" or "what does X call" rather than "what is in this file". Modes: call graph (default), import_lookup (files importing a module path), def_use (write/read sites). Fails if file path supplied; fails if impl_only=true on non-Rust directory; fails if summary=true and cursor. match_mode controls name matching; git_ref restricts to changed files.

path.description: Directory path to search for the symbol

symbol.description: Symbol name to build call graph for (function or method). Example: `parse_config` finds all callers and callees of that function.

match_mode.description: Symbol matching mode (default: exact). exact: case-sensitive exact match. insensitive: case-insensitive exact match. prefix: case-insensitive prefix match. contains: case-insensitive substring match.

follow_depth.description: Call graph traversal depth for this tool (default 1). Level 1 = direct callers and callees; level 2 = one more hop, etc. Output size grows exponentially with graph branching. Warn user on levels above 2. Hard cap of 3.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth. Unset means unlimited. Use 2-3 for large monorepos.

cursor.description:
Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor` field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.
Must be a valid opaque token or omitted entirely; passing an empty string is invalid and is treated as omitted.
Mutually exclusive with summary=true; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

summary.description:
true = compact summary (totals plus directory tree, no per-file function lists); false = full output; unset = auto-summarize when output exceeds 50K chars.
Mutually exclusive with cursor; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

impl_only.description: Filter callers to impl Trait for Type blocks only. Rust only; returns INVALID_PARAMS for other languages.

mode.description: Analysis mode. call_graph (default): build a call graph for the symbol. import_lookup: find all files in the directory that import the module path given in symbol (e.g., std::collections); requires symbol to be non-empty and rejects match_mode/follow_depth/impl_only. def_use: extract write/read sites for the symbol; requires symbol to be non-empty.

git_ref.description: Restrict analysis to files changed relative to this git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA). Empty string or unset means no filtering.

distractors.name: analyze_directory
distractors.description: Tree-view of directory with LOC, function/class counts, test markers. Respects .gitignore. Paginates with next_cursor. Default max_depth=3. Large dirs (1000+ files) auto-compact to summary; pass summary=false for per-file list. git_ref restricts to files changed since a branch/tag/commit. Empty directories return zero counts.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth for overview mode only. Default: 3. Pass 0 for unlimited depth. Use 1-3 for large monorepos to manage output size. Ignored in other modes.

git_ref.description: Restrict analysis to files changed relative to this git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA). Empty string or unset means no filtering.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.

page_size.description: Files per page for pagination (default: 100). Reduce below 100 to limit response size; increase above 100 to reduce round trips.

summary.description: true = compact summary (totals plus directory tree, no per-file function lists); false = full output; unset = auto-summarize when output exceeds 50K chars. Mutually exclusive with cursor; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.
